title: approvals.yaml
description: Owner policy: where humans are required. This single file is compiled into every enforcement surface by `agentic approvals compile` (.claude/settings.json permissions, scripts/copilot.sh, .github/CODEOWNERS, .github/rulesets/main-branch.json, plus .github/rulesets/integration-branch.json when branching.mode is "integration"). Validated by hand-rolled checks in .agentic/harness/src/config.ts; this schema is documentation and editor tooling.

owner.description: GitHub handle (e.g. "@octocat") used for CODEOWNERS generation.

merge_to_main.description: human: PR + owner review required (CODEOWNERS, ruleset, ask rules).

force_push.description: never: compiled to deny rules; human: compiled to ask rules.

protected_paths.description: Paths that get CODEOWNERS entries and edit-hook protection (e.g. tests/**, .github/workflows/**).

ask.description: Verbatim Claude permission patterns compiled to .claude/settings.json permissions.ask (and denied in scripts/copilot.sh — Copilot has no ask tier).

deny.description: Verbatim patterns compiled to permissions.deny and scripts/copilot.sh --deny-tool flags.

loop.description: HARD caps enforced by the harness. CLI flags may lower these, never raise them.

branching.description: Branching model. trunk (default): PRs target main directly and merging asks a human. integration: task PRs auto-merge into the integration branch when CI is green (compiles .github/rulesets/integration-branch.json with no review rule and drops the derived gh-pr-merge ask rule); humans still gate main via the main-branch ruleset.

default_branch.description: The repository's default/protected branch. The main-branch ruleset targets refs/heads/<default_branch> and the derived push-ask rules guard it. Renaming this requires hand-editing .github/workflows/ci.yml and release-pr.yml (workflows are owner-owned).

task_branch_prefix.description: Prefix agents use for per-task branches.

integration_merge_method.description: Ruleset-enforced merge method for PRs into the integration branch.

release_merge_method.description: Ruleset-enforced merge method for the release PR into main (integration mode).
